title: Waiting page decision input (v0.5, D37, MVP-23 step 1)
description: Input of the waiting-page vectors: one fail-closed request as the gateway sees it (fail-closed reason, waiting_page.enabled, method, the request headers the decision reads, Host, the D36 website id it resolved to, the per-response jitter draw). The result is {answer, variant, language, retry_after, refresh, body, site_name, marker, problem_code} (marker and problem_code since the D37 amendment of 2026-10-29; contract/waitingpage.Decide, rules in waiting-page.md). Header values are the field values as received (a repeated header joined with ", "); absent = not sent. Never sent anywhere.

website.description: D36 website id the request resolved to; absent = none.
